2. A genuine one-way protected transition

The new injection paper contains a deterministic ejection statement stronger than a purely locally stochastic summary.

Its Lemma 6.14 gives a five-step ejection gadget. Under its decorated input conditions, the output-error budget satisfies

 $\omega_{\mathrm{out}}
=
2\omega_{\mathrm{in}}+5\omega_{\mathrm{run}}.
\tag{6}$ All quantum sites outside the surviving output register are measured or terminated in the first step. The lemma’s final gadget has no postselection condition. arxiv.org [https://arxiv.org/html/2609.39345v1?utm_source=chatgpt.com]

This permits the following composition.

Protected ejection corollary

Let  $Q_{\mathrm{out}}$  be a code on  $k$  qubits with distance at least  $\Delta_{\mathrm{out}}k$ , equipped with a polynomial-description recovery correcting all errors below half that distance.

Let  $Q_{\mathrm{inj}}$  be the source’s injection/ejection code encoding those  $k$  qubits. Assume the total allocated quantum register satisfies

 $N\le A_{\mathrm{ej}}k$ for a fixed constant  $A_{\mathrm{ej}}$ .

Start with the clean encoded unknown input

 $\operatorname{Enc}_{\mathrm{inj}}
\bigl(\operatorname{Enc}_{\mathrm{out}}(\rho)\bigr).$ After each of the five ejection steps, allow an arbitrary adversarial CPTP fault on at most

 $f=\lfloor\rho N\rfloor$ system sites, jointly with its persistent environment.

For this clean input, the output belongs to the coherent span of errors supported on at most  $5f$  sites of the surviving outer-code register. Consequently the outer recovery corrects it whenever

 $10f<\Delta_{\mathrm{out}}k.$ A sufficient constant choice is

 $\boxed{
\rho<\frac{\Delta_{\mathrm{out}}}{10A_{\mathrm{ej}}}.
}
\tag{7}$ The resulting decoded channel is the identity on the original unknown input and its reference.

This is a protected transition

 $Q_{\mathrm{inj}}\circ Q_{\mathrm{out}}
\longrightarrow Q_{\mathrm{out}},$ with a constant global adversarial radius. Neither the encoder family nor the recovery map needs to depend on a computation  $C$ .

The clean-input qualification is essential. For a noisy intermediate input, the source’s full decorated conditions remain necessary; a raw weight bound cannot simply replace them.
